chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
Forgive the shortcomings of people of virtue and honor, for whenever one of them stumbles, his hand is held by Allah, who raises him up.

key_terms.بِيَدِ اللَّهِ: In the hand of Allah (divine support)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reason for forgiving the mistakes of virtuous people?
ai.summary: In this saying from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) encourages believers to be lenient with virtuous individuals (dhawī al-muru’āt) when they stumble, as their errors are often accompanied by divine elevation. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that forgiveness is not merely a social courtesy but a reflection of Allah’s own supportive grace, where human pardon mirrors the divine act of raising the status of the righteous. Such guidance underscores the importance of preserving the dignity of the pious while acknowledging their human fallibility.
